department: Department of Astrophysical and Planetary Sciences

deadline.value: Applications for Fall 2027 are due December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: Applications for Fall 2027 are now open and will are due December 1st, 2026.

gre_general.value: The general GRE is optional; not submitting a score does not hurt an application.
gre_general.quote: The GREs are optional. You should consider taking the GRE and reporting a score to us

gre_subject.value: Neither GRE is required; the department says GREs are optional.
gre_subject.quote: The GREs are optional. You should consider taking the GRE and reporting a score to us

fee_waiver.value: The department can give a small number of fee waivers at the admissions chair's discretion for applicants for whom the fee is a significant burden.
fee_waiver.quote: We can provide a small number of fee waivers to cover the cost of the University of Colorado application fee, at the discretion of the chair of the admissions committee.

supervisor.value: No need to contact professors before applying; most admitted students had no prior contact.
supervisor.quote: There is no need to reach out to professors before applying.

funding.value: All admitted students get a tuition waiver and guaranteed TA/RA support for the first year, and satisfactory-progress students have been supported afterwards; the department adds there are no absolute guarantees.
funding.quote: While there are no absolute guarantees, this is the situation as it has existed in the past. | All admitted students, whether domestic or international, receive a full tuition waiver and are guaranteed support as a Teaching Assistant or Research Assistant for the first year.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: PhD-only admission; about 500 applications and about 30 offers. English minimums follow the Graduate School default.
